lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple semi-regular vertical columns, typically containing 4-5 nodes per column across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a defined grid-like lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three distinct horizontal ridges in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five distinct commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral and pectoral fin regions.
